user.title: Add pool equipment
user.description: Choose the device and how Home Assistant reaches it. Each device is added on its own.

network.title: Network connection
network.description: The address of the device, or of the Modbus gateway it is wired to. The device is read before the settings are saved.

serial.title: Serial connection
serial.description: The RS-485 or RS-232 adapter on this machine and the device's line settings. The device is read before the settings are saved.

settings.title: Reading
settings.description: How often each group of values is read, and which optional parts of the device to read. Configure changes these later.

error.wrong_device: A device answered, but it does not look like the selected device type. Check the Modbus ID.
error.invalid_settings: The connection settings are not valid: {error}

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
